title: Reprint a NSW Driver Licence Receipt
summary: You can reprint a lost, damaged, or misplaced temporary paper NSW Driver Licence Receipt online using your MyServiceNSW Account.
intro: If you've renewed or replaced your NSW Driver Licence within the last month, and you've lost, damaged or misplaced your temporary paper licence (known as a Driver Licence Receipt), you can reprint it online using your MyServiceNSW Account.
who_can_apply: Must have renewed or replaced your NSW Driver Licence within the last month.
what_you_need: Driver licence or vehicle registration details

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Enter your driver licence or vehicle registration details if your account is new or you have not previously entered them.
Download your temporary paper licence PDF.

more_info.text: Your temporary paper licence is valid for 2 months from the date you renewed or replaced your driver licence.
If you've still got your old licence card, it's a good idea to carry it with your temporary paper licence until your new licence card arrives in the post.

internal_links.text: How to create a MyServiceNSW Account
Renew or upgrade a NSW driver licence

faqs.q: Who can reprint their temporary driver licence receipt?
faqs.a: You must have renewed or replaced your licence within the last month.

faqs.q: What do I need to reprint my receipt?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account and either your driver licence or vehicle registration details.

faqs.q: How do I reprint my temporary paper licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Reprint online' button, log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account, enter your details, and download the PDF.
